product.name: Pulse
product.tagline: Release notes and live status for a product people depend on.

status.message: All systems operational. No incidents in the last 11 days.

maintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenance.message: We will be upgrading database infrastructure. The API and dashboard may be briefly unavailable during this window.

releases.title: Component uptime at a glance
releases.description: Every component now shows a 90-day uptime strip, so a degraded day is visible without opening the incident log.
highlights: Hover any day for its status

releases.title: Faster first paint
releases.description: Fonts preload and the status card renders before the changelog is fetched. First paint dropped from 1.1 s to 0.4 s on a cold cache.

releases.title: Dates in the reader's locale
releases.description: Dates were shown as raw ISO strings in some browsers. They now use the visitor's locale formatting.

releases.title: Incident history
releases.description: Past incidents appear below the changelog with their start time, duration and a short post-incident summary.
highlights: Duration computed from start and resolution

releases.title: Deprecated the v0 export endpoint
releases.description: The legacy export endpoint has been removed after a six-month deprecation window. Use the v1 export with the same payload shape.

releases.title: Initial public release
releases.description: Pulse goes live as a static changelog and status page served from GitHub Pages, rendering everything from a single JSON file.

incidents.title: Delayed page updates
incidents.summary: A misconfigured deployment published a stale build for about forty minutes. Re-running the deployment restored the current content.

incidents.title: Changelog failed to load
incidents.summary: A malformed JSON entry broke rendering. The entry was corrected and a validation step was added before publishing.
